name: rosetta-smallest-enclosing-circle-problem
code:
use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

struct P(x: double, y: double) is
    +(o: P) -> P => P(x + o.x, y + o.y)
    -(o: P) -> P => P(x - o.x, y - o.y)
    *(k: double) -> P => P(x * k, y * k)
    ⋅(o: P) -> double => x * o.x + y * o.y
    ×(o: P) -> double => x * o.y - y * o.x

    length: double => Math.sqrt(self ⋅ self)
si

struct CIRCLE(centre: P, radius: double) is
    contains(p: P) -> bool => (p - centre).length <= radius + 1.0e-9

    to_string() -> string =>
        "centre ({centre.x:F6}, {centre.y:F6}), radius {radius:F6}"
si

across(a: P, b: P) -> CIRCLE =>
    CIRCLE((a + b) * 0.5D, (a - b).length / 2.0D)

through(a: P, b: P, c: P) -> CIRCLE =>
    let ab = b - a in
    let ac = c - a in
    let d = 2.0D * (ab × ac) in
    let offset = P(
        (ac.y * (ab ⋅ ab) - ab.y * (ac ⋅ ac)) / d,
        (ab.x * (ac ⋅ ac) - ac.x * (ab ⋅ ab)) / d) in
    CIRCLE(a + offset, offset.length)

let random = System.Random(1857)

enclose(given: List[P]) -> CIRCLE is
    let points = LIST(given)

    for i in 0..points.count do
        let other = i + random.next(points.count - i)
        let held = points[i]

        points[i] = points[other]
        points[other] = held
    od

    let circle mut = CIRCLE(points[0], 0.0D)

    for i in 1..points.count do
        if !circle.contains(points[i]) then
            circle = CIRCLE(points[i], 0.0D)

            for j in 0..i do
                if !circle.contains(points[j]) then
                    circle = across(points[i], points[j])

                    for k in 0..j do
                        if !circle.contains(points[k]) then
                            circle =
                                through(points[i], points[j], points[k])
                        fi
                    od
                fi
            od
        fi
    od

    return circle
si

let tests = [
    [P(0.0D, 0.0D), P(0.0D, 1.0D), P(1.0D, 0.0D)],
    [P(5.0D, -2.0D), P(-3.0D, -2.0D), P(-2.0D, 5.0D),
     P(1.0D, 6.0D), P(0.0D, 2.0D)]
]

for test in tests do
    write_line(enclose(test))
od

let scattered =
    (0..60)
        |> map(_ =>
            let angle = 2.0D * Math.pi * random.next_double() in
            let r = 4.0D * Math.sqrt(random.next_double()) in
            P(1.5D * r * Math.cos(angle), r * Math.sin(angle)))
        |> collect_list()

let circle = enclose(scattered)

write_line()
write_line("60 random points: {circle}")

let image = IMAGE(400, 400)

image.view(
    circle.centre.x - 7.0D, circle.centre.y - 7.0D,
    circle.centre.x + 7.0D, circle.centre.y + 7.0D)
image.clear(252ub, 252ub, 250ub)

image.colour(40ub, 90ub, 180ub)
image.stroke(2.0D)
image.circle(circle.centre.x, circle.centre.y, circle.radius)

for p in scattered do
    if Math.abs((p - circle.centre).length - circle.radius) < 1.0e-6 then
        image.colour(210ub, 50ub, 40ub)
        image.dot(p.x, p.y, 5.0D)
    else
        image.colour(40ub, 40ub, 40ub)
        image.dot(p.x, p.y, 3.0D)
    fi
od

image.write("circle.png")

image.show("circle.png")
